title: ‘सुमरूमा द्रौपदी’ कथामा नारी शरीर {Woman’s Body in the Story “Sumaruma Draupadi”}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा नारीवादी समालोचनात्मक पद्धतिअन्तर्गत प्रचलित अवधारणा नारी शरीरलाई आधार बनाई अभय श्रेष्ठको ‘सुमरूमा द्रौपदी’कथामा प्रयुक्त नारी शरीरमाथि भएको प्रयोगलाई प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । यसमा मूलरूपमा मिसेलफुकोको मान्यता र लुसी इरिगेरी, जुलिया क्रिस्तेभाको नारी शरीरका सम्बन्धमा प्रस्तुत अवधारणालाई आधार बनाइएकोछ । नारी शरीर सम्बन्धी मान्यताका कसीमा कथा विश्लेषणका लागि पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययन पद्धतिका आधारमा सामग्री सङकलन गरी पाठ विश्लेषण विधिको अवलम्बन गरिएको छ । ‘सुमरूमा द्रौपदी’कथामा धर्म तथा सामाजिक मूल्यमान्यताका आधारमा पितृसत्तात्मक सामाजिक विचारधाराले नारीलाई अधीनस्थ बनाएको र शोषण गरी नारी अधिकारबाट वञ्चित गराइएको विषय मार्मिक रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरी प्रतिरोध कार्यलाई पनि देखाइएका छ ।  यस कथामा पुरुषप्रधान समाजमा नारीको शरीरमाथि पुरुषको अधिकार हुने, नारी पुरुषको स्वार्थपूर्तिमा वस्तुकरण हुनु पर्ने, नारीले आफनो देहलाई माया नगरी अरुकै लागि बनाइएको मान्ने जस्ता विषयको खोजी प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुतकथामा नारी शरीर शोषण र दमनमा रही अधीनस्थ अवस्थामा रहेको हुनाले त्यसको विरोध र स्वअस्तित्वको खोजीका लागि नारीचेतना जागरूप बनेका निष्कर्ष यस अध्ययनमा रहेको छ ।  {         The usage of the female body in Abhay Shrestha's short story "Sumruma Draupadi," whichis based on the popular conception of the female body, is presented in the current researchusing a feminist critical methodology. It is mostly based on Michel Foucault's theory andthe notion of the feminine body put out by Lucy Irigieri and Julia Kristeva. The data for thenarrative analysis of the beliefs about the female body has been gathered using the textualanalysis approach, which is based on the library study method. On the basis of religion andsocietal ideals, the patriarchal social philosophy has oppressed women in the narrative"Sumruma Draupadi," making them subordinate and robbing them of their rights. Males'srights over women's bodies in this narrative, as well as women's need to be objectified formen to feel whole, have all been studied in this study. Men also have rights over women'sbodies in a society where men predominate. According to the study's findings, women'sbodies are exploited and oppressed in the tale that is being told, and their awareness hasbeen aroused to fight against this and seek for self-existence.}
american_english: Drawing upon the prevalent concept of the female body within feminist critical methodology, the present study presents the treatment of the female body used in Abhay Shrestha's story 'Sumaruma Draupadi'. It is primarily based on the ideas of Michel Foucault and the concepts regarding the female body put forward by Luce Irigaray and Julia Kristeva. To analyze the story against the touchstone of theories concerning the female body, materials were gathered through a library research method and a textual analysis method was adopted. In the story 'Sumaruma Draupadi', the poignant depiction of how patriarchal social ideology subordinates women on the basis of religion and social values, exploits them, and deprives them of women's rights is presented, while acts of resistance are also shown. In this story, issues such as men having authority over women's bodies in a male-dominated society, women having to be objectified to serve men's self-interest, and women not cherishing their own bodies but regarding them as created solely for others are investigated in the present study. Because the female body remains in a subordinate state through exploitation and oppression in the featured story, the conclusion of this study is that female consciousness has awakened to resist this and search for self-existence.

informal_english: Drawing on the common notion of the female body in feminist critical methodology, this study shows the treatment of the female body used in Abhay Shrestha's story 'Sumaruma Draupadi'. It's mainly based on Michel Foucault's ideas and the notions about the female body put forward by Luce Irigaray and Julia Kristeva. To analyse the story against theories of the female body, materials were gathered through library research and a textual analysis method was taken up. In the story 'Sumaruma Draupadi', how patriarchal social ideology keeps women under the thumb on the back of religion and social values, exploits them, and deprives them of women's rights is poignantly laid out, while acts of resistance are shown as well. In this story, things like men having authority over women's bodies in a male-dominated society, women being objectified just to suit men, and women not loving their own bodies but thinking they were only made for others are looked into in this study. Because the female body is kept subordinate through exploitation and oppression in the story, the study comes to the conclusion that female consciousness has woken up to resist this and search for self-existence.
